heroHeadline: Chiefs of Staff Meet in Riyadh as France Steps In With Troops for Yanbu
heroSubtitle: Turkey's and Pakistan's top generals met their Saudi counterparts in Riyadh on Sep 25 for the Mecca pact's first chiefs-of-staff talks since the Houthi barrage began, with Turkish FM Hakan Fidan telling critics of the alliance's slow start "we have just started." Hours earlier, French President Emmanuel Macron announced Paris would send troops, radar and air-defense systems to protect Saudi Arabia's Yanbu oil port — a bilateral deployment outside the pact's own machinery that converts an earlier air-defense request into the first concrete foreign reinforcement. Pakistan and Turkey continue to frame their own contribution as "technical" rather than combat, while a Houthi spokesman has warned of an "iron fist" against direct intervention.
